title: Northern Madagascar and the islands of Nosy Be
summary: 10 days and 9 nights between Nosy Be, Ambanja and Diego-Suarez, combining cocoa plantations, rainforest, the Red Tsingy and island excursions.
stops: Nosy Be · Ambanja · Diego-Suarez · Nosy Komba · Nosy Tanikely · Nosy Sakatia · Nosy Iranja
tip: Boat excursions depend on sea conditions. Wildlife sightings are subject to natural conditions. Accommodation is subject to availability.
overview: Explore northern Madagascar on a 10-day, 9-night journey. Discover Ambanja’s cocoa country and Ambobaka by pirogue before continuing to the Red Tsingy, Diego-Suarez, the Three Bays and Amber Mountain.
Return to Nosy Be for shared boat excursions to Nosy Komba and Nosy Tanikely, Nosy Sakatia and Nosy Iranja.
highlights: Red Tsingy, Three Bays and Ramena
Guided rainforest walk in Amber Mountain
Island villages, snorkelling and Nosy Iranja sandbar
included: Airport welcome and scheduled transfers
Guide, driver and air-conditioned 4x4 with fuel for the northern circuit
9 nights in the hotels listed, subject to availability
Breakfasts and dinners
Park entrance fees and scheduled excursions
Lunches during excursions
One bottle of water per person per day
excluded: Visa and travel insurance, medical assistance and repatriation

itinerary.title: Arrival in Nosy Be
itinerary.text: Airport welcome by your guide and driver, transfer to the hotel and time to rest.

itinerary.title: Nosy Be – Ambanja – Ambobaka
itinerary.text: Depart at 07:00 for Hell-Ville and the crossing to Ankify. Visit an Ambanja cocoa plantation, then take a traditional pirogue along the Ramena river to Ambobaka waterfall and its natural pools. Lunch at a local restaurant.

itinerary.title: Ambanja – Red Tsingy – Diego-Suarez
itinerary.text: Depart at 08:00 towards Diego-Suarez. Walk among the red and orange formations of the Red Tsingy, with time for photographs and lunch at a local restaurant. Continue to Diego-Suarez.

itinerary.title: The Three Bays and Ramena
itinerary.text: Discover Sakalava Bay, Pigeons Bay and Dunes Bay, with views of Nosy Lonjo along the way. Lunch in Ramena, followed by time in the fishing village, on the beach and in the sea. Return to Diego-Suarez.

itinerary.title: Amber Mountain and Diego-Suarez
itinerary.text: Drive to Joffreville for a guided walk of about 2½–3 hours in Amber Mountain National Park. Explore rainforest, waterfalls and volcanic lakes, looking for lemurs, chameleons and birds. After lunch, return for a city visit.

itinerary.title: Diego-Suarez – Ankify – Nosy Be
itinerary.text: Depart at 07:00 for Ankify, around 4–5 hours away. Cross to Hell-Ville by boat in about 30–45 minutes, depending on sea conditions, then transfer to your hotel in Nosy Be.

itinerary.title: Nosy Komba and Nosy Tanikely
itinerary.text: Join a shared boat excursion to Nosy Komba. Visit Ampangorina, meet local craftspeople and observe lemurs. Continue to Nosy Tanikely marine reserve for snorkelling, lunch and beach time before returning to Nosy Be.

itinerary.title: Nosy Sakatia
itinerary.text: A shared boat excursion to Nosy Sakatia, the orchid island. Discover its village and tropical vegetation, snorkel in search of sea turtles, then enjoy lunch and time on the beach. Wildlife sightings depend on natural conditions.

itinerary.title: Nosy Iranja
itinerary.text: Shared boat excursion to Nosy Iranja, about 1½ hours from Nosy Be. Explore the two islets and their sandbar at low tide, visit the village, then enjoy lunch, swimming and beach time. Return in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Departure from Nosy Be
itinerary.text: After breakfast, enjoy your last moments in Nosy Be. A market stop is possible if flight times allow. Transfer to Fascene international airport for your departure.

title: Andasibe, Kirindy and the Tsingy of Bemaraha
summary: 11 days and 10 nights exploring Madagascar’s biodiversity, from eastern rainforests to Kirindy, the Tsingy of Bemaraha and the Avenue of the Baobabs.
stops: Antananarivo · Andasibe · Mantadia · Kirindy · Bekopaka · Morondava · Ambohimanga
tip: Road and ferry conditions affect travel times. Hotels and domestic flights are subject to availability and confirmation.
overview: An 11-day, 10-night nature circuit combining Andasibe and Mantadia with the dry forest of Kirindy and the limestone landscapes of Bemaraha.
Discover the Manambolo Gorge by pirogue, walk in the Small and Great Tsingy, enjoy the Avenue of the Baobabs and end with Ambohimanga and Antananarivo.
highlights: Peyrieras, Vakona and a night walk in VOI
Mantadia rainforest and Kirindy by day and night
Manambolo Gorge, Small and Great Tsingy
Sunset at the Avenue of the Baobabs and Ambohimanga
included: Airport welcome and scheduled transfers
10 nights in a double room with breakfast, subject to availability
Private vehicles, experienced drivers and 4x4 for track sections
Fuel, scheduled ferries and road tolls
Entrance fees and local guides for scheduled visits
Night walks, guided treks and Manambolo pirogue excursion
Return domestic flights Antananarivo–Morondava, subject to confirmation
Italian-speaking Noziwild assistance
excluded: Visa, travel insurance, medical assistance and repatriation

itinerary.title: Arrival in Antananarivo
itinerary.text: Welcome at Ivato international airport and transfer to your hotel. Settle in and rest after your journey.

itinerary.title: Antananarivo – Marozevo – Andasibe
itinerary.text: Travel to Andasibe, allowing around 4–5 hours excluding visits. Stop at Peyrieras reserve in Marozevo, visit Vakona reserve for lemurs and take a guided night walk in the VOI reserve.

itinerary.title: Mantadia – Antananarivo
itinerary.text: Guided walk of about 3–4 hours in Mantadia National Park, among rainforest and wild orchids, with opportunities to observe indri, diademed sifaka, birds and reptiles. Return to Antananarivo.

itinerary.title: Antananarivo – Morondava – Kirindy
itinerary.text: Domestic flight to Morondava, then travel by 4x4 to Marofandilia. In the evening, take a guided night walk in Kirindy forest in search of nocturnal lemurs, reptiles and the fossa.

itinerary.title: Kirindy – Belo-sur-Tsiribihina – Bekopaka
itinerary.text: Morning visit of Kirindy dry forest, around two hours. Continue by 4x4 through Menabe, cross the river by ferry at Belo-sur-Tsiribihina and reach Bekopaka according to track conditions.

itinerary.title: Manambolo Gorge and Small Tsingy
itinerary.text: A traditional pirogue trip through Manambolo Gorge, followed by a guided walk through the Small Tsingy. Explore limestone formations, accessible caves and viewpoints. Allow about 4–5 hours for the visits.

itinerary.title: Great Tsingy of Bemaraha
itinerary.text: Travel by 4x4 to the Great Tsingy for a guided trek of about 4–5 hours. Explore limestone pinnacles, rocky passages, caves and suspension bridges. Return to Bekopaka in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Bekopaka – Avenue of the Baobabs – Morondava
itinerary.text: Early departure for a journey of around 8–10 hours, depending on tracks and ferries. Return via Belo-sur-Tsiribihina, stopping at the Avenue of the Baobabs for sunset before reaching Morondava.

itinerary.title: Morondava – Antananarivo
itinerary.text: Free time by the sea depending on the flight schedule. Transfer to Morondava airport, domestic flight to Antananarivo and transfer to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Ambohimanga and Antananarivo
itinerary.text: Visit the Royal Hill of Ambohimanga and discover Merina history and traditions. Return to Antananarivo for its lively neighbourhoods, markets and viewpoints.

itinerary.title: Departure from Antananarivo
itinerary.text: Enjoy your last morning in the capital, with a market or craft shop stop if time permits. Transfer to Ivato airport according to your flight schedule and traffic conditions.

title: Vezo culture and photography in southwest Madagascar
summary: 12 days and 11 nights in Madagascar, exploring Vezo fishing villages, Tsimanampetsotsa, Ifaty and the coast of Salary and Ambatomilo.
stops: Antananarivo · Toliara · Anakao · Tsimanampetsotsa · Ifaty · Salary / Ambatomilo
tip: Visits and photography in villages require residents’ agreement. Sea crossings depend on conditions. Hotels and flights are subject to availability.
overview: A 12-day, 11-night itinerary in Madagascar, counted from arrival in Antananarivo to departure. Explore the southwest through Vezo communities, spiny forests, baobabs and coastal landscapes.

Travel through Toliara, Anakao, Tsimanampetsotsa and Ifaty, with two nights in Salary / Ambatomilo before returning to Toliara. Encounters and photography respect local customs and residents’ consent.
highlights: Vezo fishing villages, pirogues and maritime traditions
Salt lake and baobabs of Tsimanampetsotsa
Ifaty spiny forest and endemic plants
Coastal tracks, dunes and two nights in Ambatomilo
included: Italian-speaking Noziwild guide and local assistance
Airport welcome and scheduled transfers
11 nights with breakfast in the listed hotels, subject to availability
Private land transport and 4x4 vehicles with drivers and fuel
Scheduled boat transfers between Toliara and Anakao
Local guides, Tsimanampetsotsa and Ifaty forest visits
Scheduled cultural encounters and visits, with local agreement
excluded: Visa, insurance, medical assistance and repatriation
Personal itinerary changes and specific photography or filming permits

itinerary.title: Arrival in Antananarivo
itinerary.text: Welcome at Ivato airport and transfer to your hotel. Rest and meet the team for an introduction to the journey.

itinerary.title: Antananarivo – Toliara
itinerary.text: Domestic flight to Toliara and welcome by the local team. Depending on your arrival time, discover the town and its coastline.

itinerary.title: Toliara – Anakao
itinerary.text: Boat crossing to Anakao, subject to sea conditions. Visit the Vezo fishing village and discover traditional pirogues and maritime life. Relax on the coast towards sunset.

itinerary.title: Anakao and Vezo villages
itinerary.text: Spend the day with a local guide discovering Vezo communities, artisanal fishing, nets and pirogues. A traditional pirogue outing may be arranged depending on weather and availability.

itinerary.title: Anakao – Tsimanampetsotsa
itinerary.text: Travel by 4x4 through arid landscapes to Tsimanampetsotsa National Park. Guided exploration of the salt lake, baobabs and dry forest, with opportunities to observe birds and reptiles.

itinerary.title: Tsimanampetsotsa – Anakao – Toliara
itinerary.text: Return by 4x4 to Anakao through villages and spiny vegetation. Continue to Toliara by speedboat, subject to navigation conditions, then transfer to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Toliara – Ifaty
itinerary.text: Follow the coast to Ifaty. Take a guided walk in the spiny forest among baobabs, pachypodium and endemic plants, with a coastal village visit if time allows.

itinerary.title: Ifaty – Salary / Ambatomilo
itinerary.text: Travel north by 4x4 along coastal tracks, passing dunes and fishing villages. Landscape and village stops are arranged with a local guide and residents’ agreement. Settle in at Ambatomilo.

itinerary.title: Salary / Ambatomilo and the Vezo coast
itinerary.text: Explore the coastal landscapes and Vezo communities around Salary and Ambatomilo with a local guide. Stops and photography are arranged with residents’ consent. Return for a second night at the same lodge.

itinerary.title: Salary / Ambatomilo – Toliara
itinerary.text: Early departure towards Toliara by the coastal route or an alternative according to track conditions. Stops for landscapes and village life along the way.

itinerary.title: Toliara – Antananarivo
itinerary.text: Transfer to Toliara airport and domestic flight to Antananarivo, subject to the airline schedule. Hotel transfer and time to rest or enjoy a final visit of the capital.

itinerary.title: Departure from Madagascar
itinerary.text: A final market or craft shop visit may be possible before your flight. Transfer to Ivato airport with assistance from the Noziwild team.
